Seasonal briefing for a productive stint
Please take a moment
Travelers should review companion animal steps before departure.

Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to keep the process clear, calm, and fair. Please share your animal's species, temperament, and comfort needs early so the team can match the trip to the animal, not the other way around. <<FACT F060>> Bring only the papers and carrier details asked for by staff, and make sure your animal is ready for screening without last-minute stress.

Good planning protects both you and your animal. <<FACT F077>> The desk can also advise on feeding, water, rest breaks, and the best way to reduce noise, heat, and crowding during the trip. If your animal is anxious, tell the desk upfront so the team can suggest a better setup and avoid rushed decisions at the airport.

For help with any companion animal booking, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
